description:
Scope: planning-only handoff for uncovered lib/mix/tasks/retrieval.eval.embed.ex lines 22,24,26,27,29,31-33,36,38-39,42,46,48-50,55. No production changes planned. Action reuse: not applicable (test-only invocation of existing Mix task, Preparation, Fixtures, EmbeddingClient). Owner: test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_task_test.exs (new separate async: false Zaq.DataCase module); leave test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_test.exs (existing async: true preparation unit tests) intact. No E2E/new feature gate.

1. Test harness: use Zaq.DataCase async: false (real System configuration in SQL sandbox), Zaq.SystemConfigFixtures.seed_embedding_config/1 for valid model/dimension/credential endpoint, Mix.Shell.Process to receive {:mix_shell,:info,[text]}, on_exit restore previous shell, and Mix.Task.reenable(\"retrieval.eval.embed\") before any Mix.Task.run invocation. Invoke Mix.Tasks.Retrieval.Eval.Embed.run/1 directly for fine-grained invalid args, optionally Mix.Task.run for one command registration check. Explicit --path always points to per-test uniquely named temporary root. Reuse/carefully extract existing with_fixture_copy and clear_embeddings from test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_test.exs into test/support/retrieval_eval_fixture_helpers.ex ONLY if needed; otherwise keep small local helper that copies the required 3 document JSONs and english-travel question to isolated root, clears embedding/provenance as current test helper does, and removes only owned root on_exit. Do not edit checked-in fixture JSON. Req.Test.stub(Zaq.Embedding.Client, fn conn -> assert request model and extract input using Plug.Conn.read_body; Req.Test.json(conn,%{\"data\" => [%{\"embedding\" => [1.0,0.0]}]}) end) at existing HTTP seam; no real network, no Mox for internal preparation. Mirror test/zaq/embedding/client_test.exs Req.Test setup/config if needed; assert observed call count only where contract-relevant. Avoid sleeps.

2. Option parsing / fail fast: run([\"--path\", root, \"surplus\"]) and assert Mix.Error 'Unexpected arguments: [\"surplus\"]'; proves 22/24 and early rejection before app start/config/filesystem/network, no shell messages and no modified fixture files. Also assert unknown flag raises OptionParser.ParseError; no unnecessary mocks. For invalid configuration, set Zaq.System.set_config(\"embedding.model\", \"\") or dimension \"0\" in sandbox and invoke run([\"--path\", root]); assert exact actionable Mix.Error and no provider calls/no writes; covers 26,27,46,48-50. Check each independently (empty model, zero dimension; optional negative dimension) if persisted reader preserves values. Don't create impossible invalid endpoint through unsafe DB bypass; endpoint guard remains evaluated by valid config (unless supported credential fixture permits empty endpoint), avoid global function mocks.

3. Successful CLI with explicit --path: seed model test-model/dimension 2 and Req.Test stub, call run([\"--path\", root]) on cleared fixture copy; assert returned :ok, exactly one summary 'Prepared N unique input embeddings; updated M fixture files' with N>0/M>0, subsequent per-path messages match actual files modified (no unrelated paths, stable order from Preparation), JSON loads with correct provenance/model/vector dimension, question text/expectations unchanged. On second call without --refresh, fail stub if HTTP invoked; summary 0/0 and no path messages; hashes unchanged. Covers 29,31-33 default refresh false,36,38-39,42,55; real EmbeddingClient/Preparation and tested HTTP boundary.

4. Refresh CLI: first populate root; install distinct valid Req.Test stub returning [0.0,1.0], call run([\"--path\", root, \"--refresh\"]), assert positive embedded and updated counts, path messages match actual updated files, all stored vectors now [0.0,1.0] with matching provenance. Covers option true at 33; assert no alteration to authored questions or relevance.

5. Default path branch 29: seed config matching bundled fixture embedding space (bge-multilingual-gemma2,3584); before run([]), verify Fixtures.load!(Fixtures.default_path(), :prepare) reports compatible complete embedding space and snapshot bytes of all tracked JSON files. Stub client to fail immediately if called; assert summary 'Prepared 0 unique input embeddings; updated 0 fixture files', no path messages, all bytes unchanged. Only attempt when precondition checks pass so test never updates repository assets; if default fixture completeness is not guaranteed, avoid running against repo and instead propose an injectable root seam in a separately approved production change, not a test-only global override. This scenario exercises default branch safely without network.

6. Run only isolated test file during implementation, then issue validation per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md (mix q plus isolated tests and eventual final mix precommit before final human approval; coverage handoff after review). No full suite/coverage/quality gates in this planning task. No broad property test: this finite CLI decision table has no broad-input invariant; input hashing/vector invariants stay in existing Preparation/Fixtures unit tests. Recheck live coverage map before finalizing to account for concurrently changed files.

comments.text: Implemented the separate Mix-task CLI test module at test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_task_test.exs. Added positional/unknown-option rejection, independent model and dimension validation, HTTP-backed missing-vector preparation and idempotency, refresh, and a guarded default-path compatible-complete no-op that snapshots all fixture JSON bytes. Validation intentionally not run per coordinator instruction; ready for authorized isolated test execution after shared workers finish.
